name: נַעֲרַי
summary: Naarai son of Ezbai, one of David's mighty men (1Ch 11:37). The parallel list in Samuel has at this place “Paarai the Arbite” (פַּעֲרַי, 2Sa 23:35), so one of the two spellings has changed in copying. As Chronicles spells it, the name is formed from נַעַר, with the ending ־ַי as in other names, or read as “my young men”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Hezro the Carmelite, נַעֲרַי son of Ezbai.”
The same place in the list: “Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai (פַּעֲרַי) the Arbite.”
נְעָרֶיךָ “your young men”, the plural with suffix: the form the name may be.

note: Only a clear name of this root as Chronicles spells it; 2Sa 23:35 has פַּעֲרַי, and which spelling is original is not settled. If Paarai, the name is from פער “open wide” and does not belong here. TIPNR records Naarai@1Ch.11.37 and Paarai@2Sa.23.35 as two people; only Naarai is tagged here.
